Closeout runs git worktree remove --force, which exits non-zero with \\u0027Directory not empty\\u0027 on any built worktree (node_modules, bin/obj, built wwwroot), and h9k never checks the exit code, so a folder of about 1.3 GB of ignored build output survives with no .git pointer, invisible to git worktree list and prune. Abandon keeps the whole worktree forever (4.17 GB for one archived task on TaylorDenny\\u0027s node). Fixes, cheapest first: after remove, delete the directory if it survives, then prune; have abandon clean up the way closeout does, or report the retained size; add an h9k project gc that scans wt-* folders on disk, cross-references task state, lists sizes, and removes only on confirmation (some retained worktrees are deliberate, such as a QA target).
